title: Red Laser
body:
Functionality

The Red Laser, or simply Laser, is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics for $1,800. Similar to the Material Laser, the Red Laser projects a laser that extends about 40 studs, but the laser is red rather than blue. In comparison to the Material Laser, the Red Laser does not output a signal when it hits a material; it does so when it hits another object or player. If it hits an object, it outputs a signal of 10.0, and if it hits a player, it outputs a signal of 5.0.
